shared_elements: large schematic anthropomorphic front-facing figure or body-shaped form
central circular ring or disc on the face/torso
curving brow or moustache-like lines above the central circle
multiple parallel arched bands across the middle
short vertical incised strokes hanging below the arched bands
small circular mark near the lower center
incised linear motifs on the upper portion
justification: The strongest correspondence is the distinctive face/body scheme: two round depressions flank a central circular ring, with curving lines above and several parallel arched bands below, followed by short vertical strokes and a small lower circle. The main difference is that B shows more of the upper decorated head or neck with additional incised linear motifs, while A is cropped closer to the lower front design.
